newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat in West Bank on last day of Eid al-Fitr.
newsitem.headline: Arafat in West Bank on last day of Eid al-Fitr.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat flew to Hebron from Gaza on Monday to spend the last day of the Moslem feast of Eid al-Fitr in the West Bank, witnesses said.

They said local dignitaries greeted the Palestinian leader upon his arrival for a two-day visit. It was Arafat's third trip to Hebron since Israel handed over 80 percent of the town to Palestinian self-rule on January 17.
The three-day Eid al-Fitr feast marks the end of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan.
